name: cheap
title: Budget lane - full pipeline on low-cost models
titleAr: المسار الاقتصادي — بايبلاين كامل بموديلات رخيصة
description: The full think -> code -> test -> ship shape, but every stage runs on the cheapest capable model (Luna / Gemini Flash / GLM). Deterministic scripts do the heavy scanning so the models read less.

stages.title: Think & plan
stages.prompt:
Task: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT}. Repository context is in .workbench/artifacts/context.md - read it instead of scanning the repo yourself. Produce a SHORT plan per your role contract (max 20 lines) and write it to .workbench/artifacts/plan.md.
stages.gateQuestion: Review the budget plan in plan.md - proceed?
stages.gateQuestionAr: راجع الخطة المختصرة في plan.md — نكمل؟
done: plan.md exists with Task, Steps, Acceptance criteria

stages.title: Implementation
stages.prompt: Implement the approved plan (.workbench/artifacts/plan.md) in the project at {PROJECT}. Read only the files the plan names. Write code-notes.md per your role contract.
done: Every plan step is implemented or its omission is justified in code-notes.md
code-notes.md lists changed files and how-to-verify commands

stages.title: Verify
stages.prompt: Verify the change in the project at {PROJECT}. Checks output (if any) is in .workbench/artifacts/checks.md. Write a short review.md against the plan's acceptance criteria and lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
Each acceptance criterion is marked MET / NOT MET / NOT TESTABLE

stages.title: Debug & root-cause
stages.prompt: The tester issued FAIL. Fix the failures per .workbench/artifacts/review.md in the project at {PROJECT}. Reproduce first, fix root causes only. Write/append debug.md per your role contract.
done: Every blocking finding from review.md is addressed or refuted with evidence
All previously failing commands now pass (shown in debug.md)

stages.title: Ship & deliver
stages.prompt: The change PASSED review. Package it for the project at {PROJECT} per your role contract. Mode: {SHIP_MODE}. Write ship.md.
stages.gateQuestion: Budget run finished - commit the change?
done: ship.md exists with summary, file list, commit message, and actions taken
